hurtMealLines.line: Jaspreet eats away from the haven on a short pack meal — 200 kcal from the pack, 1602 wanted — while hurt (health 1/100). The haven's shelves can't reach them out here. They walked away from Haven and haven't come back.

transcript.line: 🧭 A woman, maybe 20s is back from the west. "It's... different out there. I'll tell you about it." (Ask them what they saw.)

🛡️ Dawn at Haven. By the fire hangs an old bark cuirass, split at the seam — somebody's grandfather wore this into the treeline and came back. The shape of it is clear: bark plates laced overlapping like shingles, vine cord. Your hands don't know it yet. Your eyes do.
